baselineWritten: first run: baseline recorded, no alerts sent
baselineNote: Newly watched: {names}. Baseline recorded, everything from here is compared against it.
someFailed: Could not read: {names}. Will retry on the next run.
launchesDying: LAUNCHES ARE DYING OFF: fewer than {limit} a day for {days} days running ({values}). This is the threshold past which there is nothing left to fund the buyback and burn.
revenueDead: REVENUE BELOW THRESHOLD: on {day} the platform earned ${value} against a ${limit} floor. A buyback on that money stops mattering.
burnStalled: BURN HAS STOPPED: no movement for {hours}h. Burning is done by hand through an owner function, so a stop means the policy changed, not that something broke.
childHit: THE LAUNCHPAD DELIVERED: child coin {symbol} reached {cap} against a {limit} threshold. First sign the platform ships something other than itself.
fuelDry: BUYBACK IS RUNNING DRY: {value} ETH left the locker over {days} days, against a {limit} floor. By day: {detail}. The buyback runs on fees -- fewer fees, less burning, whatever the launch count says.
walletTokenMoved: COIN MOVED: {symbol} {change} over the day, and you hold {usd} of it.
walletThin: LIQUIDITY IS THIN: only {liq} sits under {symbol} against a {limit} floor, and you hold {usd} of it. You will not get out of that pool at the price on screen.
recovered: Stand down: {what} is back to normal.

names.lockedFloor.wallet: what is left of the bag

digestFuel: ⚡ Buyback fuel: {eth} ETH out of the locker over {days} days{split}
tokenBelow: PRICE AT YOUR LEVEL: {label} is down to {price} against your {limit} line — the moment you were waiting for.
tokenThin: LIQUIDITY IS THIN: only {liq} left under {label} against a {limit} floor.
lpLine: 🎯 {label} {price} inside {low}-{high} · {at}% up from the floor, {down}% to fall out, {up}% to run out the top holding {stock}% {symbol} · worth {value} · fees {fees}
lpLineOut: 🎯 {label} {price} is {side} the range {low}-{high} — earning nothing worth {value} · fees {fees}
lpOut: POSITION LEFT ITS RANGE: {label} at {price}, {side} {low}-{high}. It earns no fees and no points until the price comes back or you move the range.
lpBack: {label} is back inside its range at {price} ({at}% up from the floor). It is earning again.
lpEdge: POSITION IS AT THE EDGE: {label} is {gap}% {side} leaving its range (alert set at {limit}%), price {price}. Fees so far {fees}.
digestRevenue: 💰 {label} earned {value} on {day} · the {days}-day average is {average}, {offPeak}% below the peak of {peak} ({peakDay}){buyback}
revenueBuyback: · at that rate the buyback is about {buyback} a day
revenueSliding: REVENUE IS SLIDING: {label} — {days}-day average {average}, under the {limit} line and {offPeak}% off the peak. By day: {detail}. The buyback shrinks by exactly the same factor.
revenueBroken: REVENUE HAS BROKEN: {label} — {days}-day average {average}, under {limit} and {offPeak}% off the peak. By day: {detail}. A buyback that size no longer holds the price.
revenueStale: NO FIGURES: {label}'s last complete day is {day}, {days} days ago. A silent source looks like health and is not.
digestLocked: 🔒 {label}: {percent}% of supply still locked — {tokens} tokens, {value}. Unchanged since the last reading.
digestLockedReleased: 🔓 {label}: {percent}% of supply locked ({tokens} tokens, {value}). {released}% of supply already released from the peak.
lockedReleasing: THE OVERHANG IS MOVING: {label} held {was}% of supply locked, now {percent}%. {released}% of supply released — {tokens} tokens, {value}. Vesting has started; it presses the price regardless of news.
lockedFloor: LOCKED BELOW THE LINE: {label} has {percent}% of supply locked against a floor of {limit}%.
digestLocked.wallet: 🐳 {label}: holds {percent}% of supply — {tokens} tokens, {value}. Unchanged since the last reading.
digestLockedReleased.wallet: 🐳 {label}: {percent}% of supply left ({tokens} tokens, {value}). {released}% of supply sold from the peak.
lockedReleasing.wallet: THE BAG IS MOVING: {label} held {was}% of supply, now {percent}%. {released}% of supply sold — {tokens} tokens, {value}. A large holder is unloading.
lockedFloor.wallet: THE BAG IS NEARLY GONE: {label} has {percent}% of supply left against a floor of {limit}%.
freshnessStale: DATA HAS FROZEN: {label} has not refreshed for {hours}h {minutes}m against a {limit}h limit. Last build {published} UTC. The site still opens and looks alive - the numbers on it are old.
freshnessBroken: FILE UNREADABLE: {label} returns nothing usable - {error}. Worse than stale data: the page has nothing to fill itself with.
